bio.title: Third-year Bachelor of Computing student
bio.summary: Third-year Bachelor of Computing student at Belgium Campus, passionate about machine learning and practical software that saves people time—most recently building a C# quoting tool for a local business.

projects.name: Quote-Maker Automation (Mikado)
projects.description: Desktop tool that auto-generates customer quotes from a parts database, cutting prep time by ~60 % and eliminating manual calculation errors.

projects.name: Russuax Product & Events Website
projects.description: Custom information site for a baby-products retailer—product catalogue with pricing, event gallery, and contact form. (Business has since closed; site offline.)

projects.name: BC Student Wellness System - Milestone 1 (Web)
projects.description: Login/registration web app demonstrating session management, password hashing, and input validation for student wellness services.

projects.name: BC Student Wellness System - Milestone 2 (Desktop)
projects.description: Swing GUI for booking appointments, managing counsellors, and collecting feedback; complete CRUD with Derby DB.

projects.name: MongoDB Sharded Cluster Simulation
projects.description: University DBD381 project that simulates a fully distributed NoSQL system on a single machine. Scripts spin up config servers, three regional shard replica sets (EU, Asia, US), and a mongos router. A sample Express + Mongoose app routes reads/writes by region and demonstrates sharded collection design with compound indexes.

projects.name: Community Portal Web Application (WPR381)
projects.description: Team project for WPR381: a five-page community portal (Home, About, Events, Contact, Thank-You) with modular Express routing, dynamic EJS views, contact form POST -> JSON storage, and responsive dark-theme styling. Includes scripts, event/contact managers, and Nodemon dev workflow.

experience.description: Develop bespoke software for small businesses. Highlights: C# quote-automation tool for Mikado (cut prep time by ~60 %), and the Russuax baby-products website featuring product catalogue, pricing, and event gallery.
